About us — Our Practice

Third-generation, family-owned eye care in Fort Worth

Dr. Joseph Pack opened Pack Optical in 1951. Seventy-five years later it is still family owned — now in its third generation — at the same Oak Knoll Drive address. You don't just see a doctor here; you see a family.

Our values — six, kept simple

Compassionate Care

Every patient treated the way we'd treat our own family.

Education

We explain what we find and why — no jargon, no rushing.

Excellence

Top-notch technology and thorough, unhurried exams.

Family-Owned & Operated

Independent since 1951 — decisions made here, not by a chain.

Honesty & Integrity

Only the treatment, lenses and eyewear that genuinely help you.

Trust

Care Fort Worth families have handed down for three generations.

We Listen First

Exams run 30–60 minutes — up to a full hour when you need it.

One-Stop Shop

Exams, dry eye clinic, contacts, 300+ frames and a med spa — one address, one chart.

Same-Day Care

Same-day appointments and walk-ins welcome when something can't wait.

      Home › Patient Centre

      Patient Centre

      Insurance, self-checks & first-visit guide — in one place

      Everything patients ask the front desk, self-serve: check your plan, score your dry eye symptoms, find your frame shape, and know what to bring.

      Do you take my insurance?

      Most major vision and medical plans accepted; medical insurance also covers diabetic eye checks.

      Final verification happens before treatment — call 817-831-6141 or email a photo of your card to office@packoptical.com. Aesthetics are self-pay with an exact written quote first.

      Your first visit, step by step

      • Bring: insurance card, medication list, current glasses — and your contact lens box if you wear them.
      • Arrive 10 minutes early at 1217 Oak Knoll Dr. Free parking outside.
      • Exam (30–45 min): vision, eye health, retinal screening. Dilation only if needed — you'll be warned first.
      • Glasses: Essilor lenses incl. Varilux® & Crizal®, fitted in our boutique.
      • Forms: intake forms are texted to your phone before your visit — no printing, no portal password.
      Book my examEmail the office

      The 60-second dry eye check

      Five questions, scored live — burning, grittiness, screen blur, watering and drop dependence.

      Which frames suit your face?

      Pick your face shape — we show the shapes our opticians reach for first.

      Lumecca IPL

      InMode pulsed light that calms the inflammation driving most dry eye — and fades sun spots and redness at the same time.

      Forma-I RF

      Radiofrequency that warms and unblocks the meibomian oil glands, restoring the tear film drops can't fix.

      Morpheus8

      RF microneedling for face, jawline and neck — always starts with a consultation and an honest assessment.

      Write to the office

      Insurance question, contact reorder, gift card — this drafts an email to office@packoptical.com. Urgent eye problem? Call instead.

      No account, no portal — it simply drafts the email for you.

      Directions from your area

      From Downtown Fort Worth

      ~10 minutes. I-35W north to I-820 east, exit N Beach St, then Oak Knoll Dr. Or Airport Freeway (Hwy 121) east to the Beach St / Haltom Rd stretch.

      From Fort Worth Alliance

      I-35W south to I-820 east, exit N Beach St south to Oak Knoll Dr — about 20 minutes in normal traffic.

      From Keller

      South on the Rufe Snow Dr / N Beach St corridor to Oak Knoll Dr, or Hwy 377 south to I-820 east and the Beach St exit.

      From Saginaw

      East on Basswood Blvd to N Beach St, then south to Oak Knoll Dr — roughly 15 minutes.

      From North Richland Hills

      West on I-820 / Airport Freeway (Hwy 121), exit Beach St — we're between Beach St and Haltom Rd with free parking on site.

      Good to know

      Questions, answered

      Can I book eye care and aesthetics together?

      Yes — book both here online in one place, or call us and we'll arrange your eye care and aesthetics appointments for you.

      What are your hours?

      Monday, Tuesday & Thursday 7:30 AM – 5:30 PM; Wednesday 8:30 AM – 5:30 PM. Closed Friday, Saturday and Sunday.

      What should I bring to an eye exam?

      Insurance card, medication list, current glasses — and your contact lens box if you wear them.

      Does Morpheus8 / Botox require a consultation first?

      Yes — every aesthetics plan starts with a short consultation, an honest assessment and an exact quote before any treatment.

      Which insurance do you accept?

      Most major plans — VSP, EyeMed, BCBS of Texas, Aetna, Cigna, Medicare and more. Use the checker in the Patient Centre.

      I have an eye emergency. What do I do?

      Call 817-831-6141 straight away. If we're closed (Fri–Sun) and symptoms are severe, seek urgent care or the ER.

      Do you offer gift cards or text specials?

      Med spa gift cards are available in the office. Text subscribers get at most 4 messages a month; reply STOP to opt out anytime.

      Accessibility, privacy & terms

      The fine print for Pack Optical + Med Spa, Fort Worth, Texas — our accessibility statement, privacy policy and terms of use, plus a sitemap of every page.

      Accessibility Statement

      Pack Optical + Med Spa, 1217 Oak Knoll Drive, Fort Worth, TX 76117, is committed to making this website usable for everyone, including people using assistive technology. The practice itself is wheelchair accessible. If any page is hard to use, call 817-831-6141 or email office@packoptical.com and we will help you another way.

      Privacy Policy

      Who we are: Pack Optical + Med Spa, Fort Worth, Texas. Contact: office@packoptical.com · 817-831-6141.

      What we collect: only what you give us — name, phone and email when you book, message us, or check insurance — plus standard anonymous website analytics. We do not sell personal information.

      Texts & calls: by providing your phone number you consent to calls and texts about appointments and marketing. Pack Med Spa sends at most ~4 marketing texts a month; reply STOP to opt out. Message & data rates may apply.

      Health information is handled under HIPAA by the practice's clinical systems.

      Terms & Conditions

      These terms are governed by the laws of the State of Texas, USA. Content is general information, not medical advice for any individual. Offers (Packs Unlimited $99/year, 15% off sunglasses, 10% senior discount) are as stated on the Offers page and may change with notice.
